function.name: bash
function.description:
Run a read-only helper command from this rule pack (any executable on PATH may be invoked). The working directory is the pack root, so SKILL.md paths are relative. 120s timeout.
Allowed: one executable from PATH plus its arguments — not one shell line. Quoted arguments are fine; scripts in this pack are fine.
Not allowed (rejected before running): unquoted & | ; < > $ ` and newlines — i.e. no pipes, redirection, chaining, substitution, globbing or shell builtins. Wildcards (* ?) are passed literally, not expanded. For multi-step logic call one script in this pack, not several bash calls. Output is auto-truncated and stderr is captured, so `| head`, `> file` and `2>/dev/null` are unnecessary. Example: `ls -R . 2>/dev/null | head -100` is rejected; run `ls -R .` instead.
Host platform: Windows (win32, x64) — commands run as direct processes without a shell. Use Windows paths and executables on PATH with .exe or no extension (.cmd/.bat shims such as npx are rejected; ls/head/grep/sed/awk may be missing — use python/node or .exe programs); prefer `python` over `python3`. Shell builtins (cd, dir, echo, export) are unavailable.

command.description: One executable plus its arguments, e.g. "python scripts/filter_rules.py --keyword null". No pipes, redirection, chaining or substitutions; the value is not run through a shell.
